title: Knowledge settings: verify or correct the Turso group's cloud per-organization fallback sentence
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb4BAjgQ43tqy1DvVJ

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37104 (PR #37668, os-dev report 7201999210 out-of-scope finding, seat handoff 7202179921), filed by the owning zone ai-37000 under #37104 at the seat's direction, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards.
Grading: area:ai · domain:server · Task · p3 (seat-directed, low) · reach: knowledge settings page text · evidence: read, not run (cloud not measurable here).

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：设置页 Turso 说明里有一句“云部署每个组织留空即复用本组织数据库”，开源版里留空实际是打开本地 knowledge.db；需要在云版核实，不对就改。
- 谁受益：看说明配置的管理员。
- 不做会怎样：说明可能与实际行为不符；功能不受影响。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

The Turso group's English fallback text says: "In a cloud deployment with a database per organization, leave blank to reuse that organization's own database connection". In this repository an empty `turso_url` opens the store's own `knowledge.db` (Test connection says so). The cloud behaviour could not be measured from this repo.

## Acceptance

- The sentence is checked against the cloud deployment; it is kept, corrected, or moved to the cloud repo's own contribution, with all 11 locale bundles in step.
